trusted_source_context.finding: Artifact provenance.sources and its own recomputed hash do not independently bind the final accepted closure. Existing mandatory subset and unchanged prior contracts are insufficient.
trusted_source_context.trusted_source_manifest: Explicit root-controller-selected separate canonical UTF-8 JSON array of source_record rows. Root independently reviews/freezes final exact closure after recorder, consumer and wrapper exist, before actual run. Every row has exact declared source_record shape/order; paths sorted and unique. Raw file <=524288 bytes, <=1024 rows, every compact row <=512 bytes and sum of row bytes <=524288. This raw file cap is a conservative source-budget admission bound.
trusted_source_context.trusted_sha: The separate CLI SHA256 must be a native 64-character lower-case hex string from the independent root review, not derived or defaulted from provenance, fixture artifacts or an artifact-selected path. Actual raw canonical manifest SHA must equal it. Do not fabricate a historical or placeholder manifest to enable RED.
trusted_source_context.reader_semantics: Open only explicit trusted source-manifest path readonly/no-follow; hold fd, admit regular file/native size before bounded read, verify inode/device/size/mtime unchanged, strict duplicate/type/depth schema. Canonical raw bytes must equal declared-order compact source_record array. Require provenance.sources exact array path/size/hash equality with trusted frozen rows, and provenance.accepted_source_manifest_sha256 equals trusted CLI SHA. Retain existing mandatory/unchanged baseline checks as extra assertions. All source paths remain data; never open/hash/signal/delete paths from either manifest.
trusted_source_context.missing_context: Missing, malformed, unknown, mismatched or unfrozen actual accepted manifest fails closed. No independent source/binary/process proof inferred from artifact self-consistency. Actual owned test spawning and source/binary before/after checks remain root-wrapper responsibilities.
trusted_source_context.inventory: Exactly the same sixteen assertion methods; no additional behavioral case, no broader runtime or producer authority. Correction authorization waits for complete independent review findings.

run_inputs.nonce_rule: When either evidence export is enabled, require both independently selected root-owned export directories and one exact 32 lowercase hex fresh run nonce from the runner. Missing/malformed context fails closed, no default stale nonce or environment-derived process authority. Ordinary focused behavioral tests without evidence exports remain runnable and make no exported provenance claim.
run_inputs.native_process_rule: Test captures its actual own PID and native birth identity (Linux proc/self stat starttime plus actual boot_id; Mac native libproc process starttime), actual current executable SHA and while-live fixture filesystem observations. No supplied PID/birth authority, global process scan or artifact path opens. Root independently binds those diagnostic values to its actual held spawned test binary and accepted source manifest.
run_inputs.source_main_sha: For volatile b_run_binding executing_store_test_sha256, use actual compiled-in test-main bytes or independently held accepted source read; the root cross-checks against trusted exact manifest. Hashing the included current test-main bytes is allowed and must be compiled from the final frozen source, never a hard-coded historical hash.
run_inputs.filesystem: Exact mandatory shape/composite rules unchanged; actual outer TempDir device/inode and root-live statfs or longest-matching Linux mountinfo observation captured before close. No reconstruction from deleted root or sibling.
run_inputs.authority: These inputs provide recording identity only; they grant no Store service, capability, commit, target, IO or cleanup authority beyond the actual private fixture APIs.
